summary: This memo gives naming guidelines for X.500 directory pilots, meaning the early experimental directory services run by different countries and organisations. It recommends how entries should be named so the separate pilots fit together into one coherent global directory. It is informational. It was replaced by RFC 1617.

eli5.summary: When lots of people build phone books, they should agree on how names are written so every book can be combined into one big book. This paper suggests those naming rules.

questions: how to name entries in an x500 directory
